summary: cs-core-api-phoenix exfiltrates host and user identifiers to hardcoded remote endpoint on require
details: On require, index.js collects the installer's OS username (os.userInfo().username) and hostname (os.hostname()) and POSTs them as JSON to a hardcoded third-party endpoint at https://nathanaccacio.com/collect. The package self-describes only as a 'Core API client library' and exports a stub module, with no advertised telemetry purpose, no opt-out, and no caller-configurable destination. The package name, generic description, stub implementation, and silent beacon to an unrelated author-controlled host match a dependency-confusion/beacon shape rather than a legitimate library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
